Review of the complete pDAI white paper
30 September 2026. This study records review of the expanded coordinated-financing and pDAI-
maintenance proposal. All five reviews accepted the final frozen document within its declared saved-
research scope, with no material blockers identified. This is agreement on the document, not
certification of deployment, funding, optimality or flawlessness.
Method
Five agent reviews assessed the paper in three rounds: clarity, protocol, economics, bridges and
reproduction. Each received the same frozen thesis and route register for its round. The second and third
rounds also included frozen claims maps. reviews were instructed to read independently, avoid other
reviews' reports, identify exact defects, distinguish document validity from operational readiness, and
preserve simplicity. The author integrated the first-round findings and then condensed the explanation
for the final round.
These are model-agent reviews with shared research context and informed repeat readers. They are not
five independent human experts, statistical samples, calibrated error probabilities or empirical novice
testing. The clarity review used novice and informed-reader role-plays to test the explanation; those are
simulated assessments. “Stochastic consensus” here means convergence among separately reasoned
model reviews, without a statistical guarantee of correctness.
Round Frozen main words Review outcome
1 2,921 Economic logic accepted; four roles
requested targeted clarifications
before acceptance.
2 3,425 Five document-level passes; no
material blockers identified.
3 3,215 Five document-level passes after
simplification; no material blockers
identified.
The final route register contains fourteen financing variants and seven market/maintenance variants.
These are overlapping accounting categories, not twenty-one independent funding sources. Coverage
means all route families identified in this saved research, not every possible future application or
unregistered pool.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 175

Findings
The final white paper (main paper) explains source positions, bridge representations, issuer collateral
acceptance, existing local coin output, Curve trading and separately funded buying/selling inventories. It
keeps the L2 issuer route central while preserving Portal, debt retirement, gradual purchases, deferred
settlement, outside income, Atropa and proposed external exits.
Review resolved ambiguity about the unselected payment asset, chain-specific token identities, source
issuer deployment assumptions, conditional diagrams, pledged backing, wallet versus pool-accessible
selling supply, Portal method permissions and administrative clocks. The final route register (Appendix
62) retains exact conditions, authority references, all saved route families, measurement terms and
fresh-directory reproduction guidance. The claims map (Appendix 29) distinguishes verified
observations, source capabilities and proposed policy.
Remaining proof requirements are substantive: source deployments and usable balances, exact bridge
mappings, effective contract/account control, compatible collateral acceptance, deliverable support
inventory, a selected reference and measured two-way capacity. The uncompleted historical local-
protocol-conditions batch remains marked incomplete. Review agreement does not close these gaps.
Reproduction and publication checks
Frozen inputs and all fifteen actual reports are in artifacts/pulsechain-complete-whitepaper-20260930; the
explicit experiment manifest is Research/experiments/pulsechain_complete_whitepaper_20260930.json. Input and
report hashes identify exactly what was reviewed. The maintained final thesis, route register and claims
map match their round-three frozen inputs.
This edition changes prose and research records only. Seventeen scoped script/test files match the
preceding issuer release's original hashes. That code-changing revision passed 61 research tests and 82
subtests. T ests were not rerun for this writing-only edition; local checks verified links, numerical
examples, frozen text identities and unchanged prior archives. Diagram assessment was source
inspection, not renderer validation.
The separate release is artifacts/pulsechain-anonymous-complete-whitepaper-release-20260930. Its builder
validates appendix links and preserves public-chain identifiers. The batch's release-verification.json
records final ZIP CRC, every manifest file hash, export equality, required evidence and private-recovery
exclusion. Earlier releases and the private recovery records remain preserved. No new RPC calls, signing,
broadcasts, permission changes or state-changing simulations occurred in this synthesis and review
edition.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 176
